policy: Curated link-only catalog. Verify code, exact runtime versions, licenses, external API terms, and authentication independently. Entries sourced from gishub.org/software are credited to Dr. Qiusheng Wu's directory; no upstream code is bundled. Esri PE is factory metadata, not proprietary engine code; SpatialReference.org is an independent PROJ-generated authority resource. Preserve official Esri UI folder terminology but do not invent unexported folder paths. OpenGeoS expansions remain discovery/engineering references: verify upstream release, package/version compatibility, data terms and licenses; listing never implies tested code or free-to-use data. GIS application/software additions marked repository_access_checked_on are accessible public GitHub repositories as of that date, not runtime-tested installations. license_metadata_unverified is preliminary GitHub metadata; license remains verify-upstream until file-level and dependency review.
